name: Storing the same usage twice does not double it

planSteps.description: Open the app, wait for the initial solve, and click 'Use a sample'.
Click 'Store and rank' and wait, then note the total energy shown beneath the ranked list.
Click 'Store and rank' a second time with the same textarea contents and wait.
Verify the total energy shown beneath the ranked list is the SAME as before, not doubled, and that a note appears saying intervals were already stored so nothing was duplicated.
Verify the ranked list is cleared and a note reports how many intervals were removed.
Verify the section states that nothing is stored yet, rather than showing an empty or stale ranking.
